def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Fix island label variants (strip leading/trailing spaces)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Fix species label variants (Adeile -> Adelie)
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    
    # Fix sex case variants (FEMALE -> female)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    # Fix out of range body_mass_g (4850000 is likely 4850 - divide by 1000)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count penguins per island
    counts = df.groupby('island').size().to_dict()
    return counts
